hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer ASCII punctuation glyph smoke
hardware.tested_state: rebuilt and reflashed after adding caret and backtick review-display glyph coverage

procedure: Ran NostrSeal/esp32 make ci, including host-core review-page and raster regression tests for literal caret and backtick rendering.
Sourced /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell used for build, flash, and smoke.
Built firmware revision fedcb5f with ESP-IDF v5.5.4; the app binary size was 0x8ea30 bytes with 0x715d0 bytes free.
Flashed the firmware to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 and verified bootloader, app, and partition-table hashes during the ESP-IDF flash operation.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-capabilities after the flash.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-review-scenarios after the capability smoke.
expected_result: The firmware image containing the caret and backtick review-glyph change should still preserve the disabled-signing USB protocol contract and keep review-scenario serial behavior deterministic.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built clean app version fedcb5f with binary size 0x8ea30 and 0x715d0 bytes free in the app partition. esptool detected ESP32-S3 QFN56 revision v0.2 with native USB-Serial/JTAG and MAC ec:da:3b:95:32:98, wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images, and verified hashes. The capability smoke passed with 39 verified exchanges, 9 response frames, and 30 expected rejection frames. The review-scenario smoke passed with 7 scenarios, 8 verified exchanges, 7 response frames, and 1 expected rejection frame. sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: This report validates the host-tested caret/backtick glyph regression and post-flash USB serial protocol behavior only.
It is not a full manual visual acceptance run for every glyph, physical button approval test, camera test, QR flow test, key provisioning test, storage test, or real signing test.
The T-Display S3 bitmap-font path still represents unsupported non-ASCII content as explicit U+XXXX fallback text.

The run does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, full Unicode review rendering acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, secure boot, flash encryption, debug lock, companion signed-output verification for real signatures, or production signing readiness.
sign_event remains signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
